approaches.method: Integral Seifert monodromy and cyclotomic algebra
approaches.proved: Definiteness forces finite-order integral homological monodromy; squarefree cyclotomic Baker-Kegel family also has finite-order homological action but nondefinite form.
approaches.gap: Finite homological order does not imply periodic geometric monodromy, even among hyperbolic L-space knots; the definite case is not excluded.

approaches.method: Boundary rotation and taut foliation construction
approaches.proved: The direct criterion settles c>=1/2; for 0<c<1/2 the exceptional integral fillings are exactly q=0,1; time doubling does not remove fiberwise orientation obstruction.
approaches.gap: Construct a co-oriented taut foliation extending over q=0 in the remaining interval.

approaches.method: Positive Hopf-tree geometry and definite ADE lattice classification
approaches.proved: A complete elementary tree classification yields the known nonhyperbolic knot boundaries under the standard arborescent tree-plumbing hypothesis.
approaches.gap: No justified geometric tree-plumbing model for arbitrary definite L-space-knot fibers; lattice congruence is insufficient.

approaches.method: Floer surgery exact triangle on the twofold exterior
approaches.proved: All integral meridian-plus-longitude fillings have H1 order D; explicit exact triangles show neighboring excess rank need not force target excess rank.
approaches.gap: Spin-c-refined maps or a quantitative rank estimate excluding the minimal target rank are unavailable.

approaches.method: Khovanov-to-Floer spectral sequence and permanent-cycle control
approaches.proved: Excess page rank can cancel while a protected class survives; explicit filtered complexes and the published T(3,4) example demonstrate the failure of that proposed inference.
approaches.gap: A hyperbolicity-sensitive argument protecting more than D terminal classes is missing.

claims_not_made: No proof or counterexample to the full conjecture.
No general left-orderability implies non-L-space theorem.
No knot or manifold realization of the abstract rank models.
No independent reconstruction of source topological proofs or published signature computations.
